activeWorkPacket.name: Existing Ledger Runtime Convergence — ApplicationId Routing
activeWorkPacket.businessGoal: Reuse the already implemented BusinessData → Posting → Ledger/Balance runtime and simplify its boundaries: preserve the working deterministic engine, introduce one stable applicationId routing anchor, remove unnecessary dependence on rich ApplicationDefinition/version/Command metadata from the Ledger Runtime path, and keep compatibility until the simplified path is database-proven.
activeWorkPacket.evidenceTarget: IMPLEMENTED + UNIT VERIFIED + PostgreSQL E2E before replacing current compatibility path
closedGates: CORE-MIN-01 minimal EVO Runtime Plugin boundary merged by PR #56 / CI #738
ApplicationAnchor/applicationId routing architecture merged by PR #57 / CI #743
App Platform ApplicationAnchor contribution documentation merged by PR #6
openGates: inventory existing BusinessData/Posting/Ledger contracts and preserve proven behavior
map existing applicationInstanceId/applicationDefinitionId usage to one minimal applicationId routing contract
decouple Posting rule lookup from ApplicationDefinitionVersion/metadataVersion lifecycle while preserving current executable rules
introduce direct BusinessDataSubmission adapter over the existing atomic BusinessData + PostingInput creation path
keep current Command path as compatibility adapter rather than duplicate runtime logic
PostgreSQL E2E: applicationId → existing BusinessData → existing PostingService → existing Ledger/Balance
migrate Trading Lite Host adapter and rerun end-to-end browser proof
activeWorkPacket.nextAction: Do not rebuild the existing EVO Ledger Runtime. Start with an implementation inventory/diff against the existing business-data, posting and ledger modules; make the minimum bounded changes needed to expose the simplified applicationId-based runtime contract.

branchPolicy.workingRule: Use short-lived work-packet branches by default. Closely related bounded slices inside one confirmed business loop MAY be combined into one bundle branch when they share the same acceptance story and can be proven by one coherent database-E2E scenario. Merge the bundle to main before starting the next substantial independent capability.
branchPolicy.analysisRule: LLMs must use branch.topology.json plus live GitHub compare results before merge/delete/revival decisions.
branchPolicy.bundleRule: A bundle branch is allowed only when: (1) one confirmed business outcome unifies the slices; (2) acceptance and non-goals are explicit; (3) failures can still be localized to named sub-gates; (4) the PR remains reviewable; (5) database evidence covers the whole bundle; and (6) it does not introduce unrelated platform/generalization work.
branchPolicy.authorityRule: main is the only authoritative integration branch. ACTIVE_WORK branches are provisional. Once merged, mark them MERGED_MILESTONE and never merge them again.
branchPolicy.pacingRule: Do not create a branch/PR merely because a numbered sub-slice exists. Prefer one evidence-complete bundle over several mechanically small PRs when doing so reduces coordination overhead without weakening auditability.

forbiddenVolatileMarkers: uncited claims that a whole work packet is complete

requirementAlignment.rule: Keep EVO lightweight, but retain the minimal ApplicationAnchor/applicationId required to route BusinessData to current PostingRules. Rich application lifecycle, permissions, capabilities and rule-version governance remain outside Core.

alignmentCadence.rule: Perform a formal requirement-alignment review after every 3 merged DATABASE E2E VERIFIED/CERTIFIED bounded slices since the last review, or immediately when any mandatory trigger fires, whichever comes first.
